title: Spectral extremal problems on 1-planar graphs without Friendship graph
summary: Let $\textit{spex}_{\mathcal{P}_1}(n,F)$ be the maximum spectral radius among all $n$-vertex $F$-free $1$-planar graphs. Define $F_t$ as the friendship graph formed by $t$ triangles sharing exactly one common vertex. Tait and Tobin (2017)~\cite{Tait2017} used the fundamental structure of spectral extremal graphs to determine the unique planar graph with maximum spectral radius for sufficiently large order. Subsequently, Zhang, Wang and Wang (2024)~\cite{Zhang2024} characterized the corresponding extremal graph in the class of $1$-planar graphs. In this paper, we focus on $F_t$-free…
